text.en:
The name of the municipality of Quingua. Province of Bulacan, is hereby changed to that of
Plaridel, in memory of Marcelo H. del Pilar, Filipino patriot and devoted worker.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, September 8, 1936.
